lines.t: Is our new coworker from Hue?
Yes, he is. His name is Minh.
Does his family have a restaurant there?
Yes. Their restaurant serves local food.
Is it one of these places in the photos?
Yes, this one. Those small shops are across the street.
They sell coffee and local food. Their prices are good.
Does Minh know other cheap places in our city?
Yes. He knows another nice restaurant near our office.
